## Pseudo-Kobayashi Fuseki

It is an amateur fuseki that is derived from the Nirensei Fuseki. It is similar to the Kobayashi Fuseki, the only difference being that Black played on the 4-4 point rather than the 3-4 point. This formation frequently appears in beginner games and enjoyed peak popularity among professionals in the 1990s. 

Source: [Sensei’s Library](https://senseis.xmp.net/?PseudoKobayashiFuseki)
